facts.conditions: Shunt sign extension depends on PGA representation. Bus low bits are not voltage data: bit 1 CNVR, bit 0 OVF; bit 2 reserved. Raw registers do not require calibration. A negative shunt code must not become an unsigned positive current.

facts.conditions: PGA ranges are bipolar. Error table header: TA=25 C, VS=3.3 V, VIN+=12 V, VSHUNT=32 mV, PGA=/1, BRNG=1 unless specified. Over-temperature row changes TA only. INA219B tighter limits do not transfer. This is not total shunt/circuit accuracy and not an arbitrary-current guarantee. Choose shunt and PGA against peak differential voltage as well as digital range; 32 V bus scaling is not a pin-voltage allowance.

value.continuous_both_mode: 111; shunt then bus, independently configured SADC/BADC
value.triggered_both_mode: 011; writing triggered mode starts a conversion even if unchanged

facts.conditions: The 12-bit min/max table entry uses page-5 electrical header conditions; minimum is not stated. 68.10 ms is Table-5 timing, not a separately guaranteed maximum. Both-channel conversion/averaging is sequential, not simultaneous; the page-10 example allows about 68 ms between samples at 128 averaging. Reading retained data early does not make it fresh. Timing budget needs both channel settings, mode, bus/host latency and required age.
